semantics.goal: Recover and insert relative to a passively translating spring-damper fixture while keeping fixture motion, contact force, travel, and terminal stability within declared limits.
excludes: judging insertion in a fixed world frame
pushing the fixture to a mechanical stop and treating it as static
crediting short-horizon response prediction as task success
using hidden fixture mass, stiffness, or damping as policy input

evidence: fixture displacement exceeds the frozen meaningful-motion threshold after contact
fixture is not at a travel stop
insertion depth in the current fixture frame
fixture velocity and acceleration remain below frozen limits
relative insertion, wrench, and pose remain within limits for the terminal dwell

public: goal pose relative to the current fixture

success: loaded contact excites meaningful passive fixture motion away from the travel stops
the motion and recovery events precede relative insertion
insertion succeeds in the current fixture frame
fixture and connector settle for the terminal dwell within motion, force, pose, and travel limits
violations: fixture mechanical-stop impact or sustained stop contact
anti_bypass: evaluate all insertion geometry in the moving fixture frame
require meaningful fixture motion before success
require a joint fixture-and-connector stability window after insertion

requirements: source skill excites measurable fixture motion without reaching a travel stop
source completes recovery, relative insertion, and joint stabilization in event order
qualification includes fixed-fixture control and at least one moving-fixture condition
source actor, fixture parameters, and configuration digests are frozen before target development
source_qualification.evidence_resolution: physics substeps for fixture motion and contact peaks, control ticks for recovery and terminal stability

required_signals: fixture pose, twist, acceleration, and travel

historical_evidence_policy: Existing fixture probes and response-model holdouts remain development diagnostics only and are not relabeled as closed-loop compliant-fixture task results.
